briefings.title: Muse Wonder: Zuckerberg and Wang's $100B AI

people.name: Alexandr Wang
people.role: Chief AI Officer, Meta Superintelligence Labs

briefings.tldr: Mark Zuckerberg and Alexandr Wang announce the launch of Meta's frontier AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, detailing Meta Superintelligence Labs' complete talent reboot and $100B+ CapEx commitment to agentic AI and personal superintelligence.

briefings.title: Creating Muse: The Fastest-Growing AI Product Since ChatGPT | Alexandr Wang, Meta
briefings.tldr: Meta Chief AI Officer and Scale AI co-founder Alexandr Wang details the seven-month creation of Muse—the fastest-growing consumer AI product since ChatGPT—following Mark Zuckerberg’s recruitment of Wang in early 2026 after Meta's Llama 4 setback.

briefings.title: The Biggest Launch Since ChatGPT (Muse)
briefings.tldr: Meta AI Chief Alexandr Wang discusses the meteoric rise of "Muse," a consumer-facing AI agent that reached 5 million downloads in 22 days, and details the broader challenges of AI safety, agentic autonomy, privacy architecture, and industry governance.

briefings.title: Alexandr Wang: From Los Alamos to Superintelligence
briefings.tldr: Alexandr Wang (Scale AI founder, now leading Meta's superintelligence lab) shares his entrepreneurial journey and vision with Garry Tan at Startup School 2026, emphasizing that founders must develop an internal compass and strong conviction to bet on steep exponential trends before they become consensus.

briefings.title: Meta AI Chief Wang on Winning the Race in AI
briefings.tldr: At Bloomberg Tech 2026, Meta’s Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang discussed the company's aggressive transition toward frontier AI capabilities, highlighting the success of its "Muse Spark" model and its upcoming competitive "entree" model.
